items.title: Johnson & Johnson Nearing 52-Week High: Buy, Sell or Hold?
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson has surged more than 50% in a year and now sits within striking distance of its 52-week high, but a closer look at the valuation, insider activity, and pipeline pressures raises a pointed question about who actually wins from here.

items.title: How Much Did Immunology Drugs Contribute to AbbVie's Q2 Performance?
items.summary: Skyrizi and Rinvoq drive ABBV's Q2 growth, with strong sales, market-share gains and new indications supporting the immunology franchise.

items.title: Legend Biotech Gains 6% on Q2 Earnings Beat as Adjusted EPS Doubles Consensus
items.summary: Legend Biotech just posted a quarter that flipped a key narrative for LEGN shareholders, but with a CEO transition underway and the stock still down sharply over the past year, the real question is whether this momentum can last.

items.title: J&J Trading Above 200- & 50-Day SMAs: Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
items.summary: J&J's growth, new drug launches and pipeline strength support the stock, despite patent, MedTech and legal headwinds.

items.title: The Number One Reason I Keep Buying Intuitive Surgical Now For The Long Run
items.summary: Intuitive Surgical is down more than 30% this year, and one investor keeps buying anyway, convinced that a once-per-decade hardware cycle and an $8.6 billion cash fortress make the drawdown a gift rather than a warning.

items.title: Healthcare Investing Is Now an AI Short in Disguise
items.summary: For years, healthcare and semiconductor stocks weren’t particularly tied to each other.  In other words, they increasingly go in opposite directions: when chips sell off, healthcare has tended to catch a bid.  After years of underperformance, healthcare investors are enjoying a burst of momentum amid the recent nervousness around AI.

items.title: How a 65-Year-Old Turned a $950,000 401(k) Rollover Into a $4,500 Monthly Paycheck Without Buying an Annuity
items.summary: Pulling $54,000 a year from a $950,000 rollover IRA sounds like a math problem, but the real trap is hidden in the yield tier you choose and what it quietly does to your principal over time.

items.title: What Johnson & Johnson (JNJ)'s OTTAVA FDA Win and Talc Deal Shift Mean For Shareholders
items.summary: In recent months, Johnson & Johnson reported strong Q2 2026 results, received FDA De Novo authorization for its OTTAVA soft-tissue robotic surgery system, advanced its RYBREVANT FASPRO oncology franchise with an FDA Priority Review, announced a US$5.50 billion talc settlement framework, and agreed to collaborate with Sail Biomedicines on in vivo CAR-T therapies.
